headline: The receive path's missing ingredient is the DIRTY FLAG VALUE, not an extra cell. APP_rke_code_commit writes 0x40003F53 = 0xFF; VOL_test_and_clear_dirty(p,n) tests mask (0x80>>n); the only two consumers in the whole image use bit index 1 (mask 0x40) and bit index 2 (mask 0x20). The debug service writes 0x01 = mask-bit index 7, which NO consumer reads. Hence the command code persists and nothing fires.

instrument_failures_caught_and_fixed: 347 v1: def-table backward walker latched the FIRST register def and mis-resolved 0x0AEEDA to 0x40000051. Cause: self-accumulating bases (e_add16i r29,r29,0x3f02). Fixed with backward SUBSTITUTION; C1 then passed.
349 v1: mem.getBytes() with a Python bytearray silently returns all zeros through jpype -> a perfect false negative. Control failed; fixed with a Java byte[].
not_established: That bit 0x08000000 alone is sufficient -- bits 28/29 of 0x40009680 and the DAT_40003C42<0 alternative arm were not re-derived.
Runtime reachability: the 0x0AEEC6->0x0ADADA chain is a static CALL/JUMP/FALLTHROUGH closure only (AGENTS rule 43).
0x1818 vs 0x1808: the (code>>4)&1 guard is present in the 0x0ADADA listing, but bench_session_4.md records that term as refuted from the wire side. Conflict flagged, not adjudicated.
Whether tcd bit 2 (mask 0x20) alone suffices or bit 1 (mask 0x40, APP_rke_command_demux) is also needed; writing 0xFF sidesteps this.
